parsed.corrected_rationale: The answer suggests plotting "another set of boxplots in the appendix" with deviations from the initialization. However, this phrase does not pinpoint any specific existing figure, table, or experiment in the paper, so the authors cannot confidently determine which part the comment addresses. The comment does clearly specify what is being suggested, namely that the appendix boxplots should be plotted with deviations from initialization because learning rates and regularization coefficients are not directly comparable when gradient scale changes dramatically. But since the referenced part cannot be confidently identified—the suggestion only names a new addition to the appendix rather than an existing specific part—the grounding is weak rather than fully grounded. Thus the comment specifies the issue clearly but does not explicitly identify which part of the paper it addresses.
